newsitem.title: USA: Billing buys company, to post charge.
newsitem.headline: Billing buys company, to post charge.

text.p: Billing Concepts Corp said Monday that it acquired Computer Resources Management Inc and will post charges of $17.5 million against earnings as a result of its decision to acquire Computer Resources for $8.45 million in cash and 325,000 shares of common stock, valuing Computer Resources at $18 million.
The charge against earnings for research and development could account for as much as 50 percent or more of the acquisition price, Billing Concepts said in a prepared statement.
Billing Concepts said in a statement that it will expense accumulated costs incurred from the development of a direct billing system for a service bureau operation.
No restructuring costs are anticipated due to the merger, Billing Concepts said.
